name: Constrict
description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, and the ooze can't constrict another target.
